basic_details.short_information: National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) Consultant Notification 2026 has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website https://ncte.gov.in. A total of 7 Consultant vacancies have been announced through the NCTE Consultant Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NCTE Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Academic Consultant: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Consultant (MEL): Rs. 1,00,000/- per month Academic Consultant: Rs. 90,000/- per month Outreach Consultant: Rs. 75,000/- per month Graphic Cum Content Designer: Rs. 50,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NCTE Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the NCTE Consultant posts is scheduled to be held on 30th July 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant posts at NCTE?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various Consultant positions at the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the NCTE Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant posts is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the NCTE Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the NCTE Consultant positions, as indicated in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the different types of Consultant posts available in this NCTE recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts include Senior Academic Consultant, Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Consultant (MEL), Academic Consultant, Outreach Consultant, and Graphic Cum Content Designer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the NCTE Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant posts ranges from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCTE Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the NCTE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the venue for the NCTE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110075. The exact venue address will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any online application process for this NCTE recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online; they should report directly to the interview venue with their documents.
